DMA lower bound: the 10 distinct B tiles (2 k-halves x 5 n-blocks) each appear in exactly one 16x16x16 product, so all 10 must be mvin'd (2560 bytes); the 2 A k-half tiles are loaded once and reused across all 5 n-blocks (512 bytes); total 3072 bytes, achieved. Command lower bound: 1 config_ex + 2 config_ld + 1 config_st + 12 mvin (12 distinct tiles) + 10 preload (one per compute) + 10 compute + 5 mvout (C = five 16x16 tiles) + 1 fence = 42, achieved. Semantics: A k-halves at spad rows 0 and 16; per n-block j, B tile (k=0..15, offset 16j) mvin'd to spad row 32, preload out_addr 2684354560 (bit31 accumulator + bit29 full width + bit30=0 overwrite), overwrite-compute with A k-half 0 (k-order 0..15); then B tile (k=16..31, offset 1280+16j) mvin'd to row 32, preload out_addr 3758096384 (bit30=1 accumulate), compute with A k-half 1 yielding the ordered k=0..31 reduction; mvout acc rows 0-15 to C element offset 16j (column start of block j, rows written with stride 320). Scratchpad starts are multiples of 16 within 80 rows (peak 48), acc rows in [0,16), compute.bd_spad_addr always 4294967295, single final fence."}
